title: International telework exceptions need sponsor decisions
remediation: The sponsor international telework authority establishes exceptional access criteria and identifies the applicable departmental approval officials. Where use is permitted, sample a time-limited request with location and personnel risk assessment, security briefing, approvals and end-of-access evidence. Where prohibited or outside scope, submit the policy and deployment boundary to the assessor for review.

milestones.title: Collect the approved restriction and one sanitized exception decision with risk assessment and expiry, or documented prohibited-use scope
